$comment: Contract for data/tables/headline_definitions.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js; semantics by build/src/registry.js.
title: Headline definitions
description: One row per headline the selector compares materials on. The build and the app read everything about a headline from here: which measurements may back it, its unit, direction and load, its labels, filter, chart axis, table column and export header. A new headline is a new row plus its selections in headlines.csv.

fields.name: HeadlineKey
fields.description: Stable key used in scenarios, links and exports. Never rename a published key.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: measurement: backed by a selected measurement; price: the median price per kg of the products' listings, Canadian where a product has one, else converted (D113).

fields.name: Unit
fields.description: The headline's unit; a backing measurement must carry it.

fields.name: Value properties
fields.description: Properties whose measurement may be the headline value.

fields.name: Related properties
fields.description: Properties shown as related evidence when the headline has no value; the first is the headline's own endpoint.

fields.name: Lower bound properties
fields.description: Properties whose printed measurement of a material bounds its headline from below (an implied bound). It vetoes a screen it meets, limits the estimate from below, and never passes a requirement (DECISIONS D48, D55).

fields.name: Lower bound load MPa
fields.description: Test load a bounding measurement must state (HDT at 1.8 MPa bounds HDT at 0.45 MPa).

fields.name: Lower bound excludes
fields.description: Moisture state whose measurements bound nothing (a conditioned nylon stretches further than a dry one).

fields.name: Lower bound basis
fields.description: Why the bound holds.

fields.name: Direction
fields.description: Print direction a backing measurement must have.

fields.name: Unstated direction
fields.description: What a measurement whose source states no direction is to a headline with a Direction: as-published, a value that may be this direction and is counted apart (D84; a flat bar is how makers test unless they say otherwise); or excluded, no value of it at all (D92; a maker who pulls a bar across its layers says so). Not applicable where Direction is.

fields.name: Load MPa
fields.description: Test load the headline is defined at; a backing measurement with an unstated load is flagged.

fields.name: Notch
fields.description: The notch a backing impact measurement must state (D92): a value with another notch, or none stated, is no value of the headline and stays evidence. Not applicable: the headline is not an impact test.

fields.name: Test temperature °C
fields.description: The test temperature the headline is defined at (D92): a backing measurement whose Test temperature °C is stated and more than 2 °C from it (the standard laboratory atmosphere of ISO 291 and ASTM D618 is 23 ± 2 °C) is no value of the headline; one that states none counts. Not applicable: any.

fields.name: Standard
fields.description: The test standard a backing measurement that names one must name (D94): a value whose Standards name others and not this one is no value of the headline and stays evidence (an Izod value to ASTM D256, even printed in kJ/m², is that test's energy per metre of notch converted by its maker, not an ISO 180 bar); one that names no standard counts. Not applicable: any.

fields.name: Changes with annealing
fields.description: Whether annealing changes the part's value (D99): a value measured after an annealing schedule is the product's in that annealed state only, and decides where the scenario permits annealing; one as printed or unstated decides the as-printed state. FALSE: the value is the product's in every state (a density is the resin's).

fields.name: Changes with moisture
fields.description: Whether absorbed water changes the part's value (D99): a value measured after moisture conditioning is the product's conditioned value, which decides where the scenario asks about the conditioned service state; one dry or unstated decides the dry state. FALSE: the value is the product's in every service state.

fields.name: Evidence group
fields.description: Which citation list the headline's evidence joins.

fields.name: Endpoint note
fields.description: Whether related evidence of a non-first property is labelled as a different endpoint.

fields.name: Comparison note
fields.description: What the headline compares, and why its related values that are not its own (another test, unit, notch, direction or temperature) are left out, in a reader's words. The drawer shows it beside those values (D92). Not applicable: the per-value reason says enough.

fields.name: Short
fields.description: Column and pill label.

fields.name: Plain
fields.description: Plain-language name.

fields.name: Technical
fields.description: Technical name, shown as a subtitle.

fields.name: Hint
fields.description: What the number means to a user.

fields.name: Axis label
fields.description: Chart axis title.

fields.name: Export header
fields.description: CSV export column header.

fields.name: Better
fields.description: Whether lower or higher is better (Pareto direction).

fields.name: Filter group
fields.description: Filter rail group.

fields.name: Filter operator
fields.description: Default comparison in the filter rail.

fields.name: Filter example
fields.description: Example shown under the filter input.

fields.name: Non-negative
fields.description: Whether a negative requirement is rejected.

fields.name: Table column
fields.description: Whether the Properties table shows it by default.

fields.name: Estimated
fields.description: Whether the estimate model predicts it when missing; needs entries in build/mappings/estimate-model.json.

fields.name: Reference property
fields.description: Generic reference envelope drawn against this headline on charts.

fields.name: Applies to
fields.description: Which materials the headline applies to (same syntax as properties.csv). Blank: all. Outside it the headline is Not applicable, with the reason below.

fields.name: Not applicable reason
fields.description: Why the headline does not apply outside 'Applies to'; required when it is set.
